investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 — All Three Remote-Agent Checks Failing with Identical Bad-Gateway Error
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-01T12:40 with an identical 502 bad-gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2) was unreachable when POST /api/agents was called. Because every check shares the same error message and no evidence was collected by any of them, the failure is localized to the shared upstream swarm gateway dependency, not to any individual check's logic.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway backing POST /api/agents (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents) returned a 502 bad-gateway response during agent provisioning. This caused the production-api to surface code "bad_gateway" to the eval runner, which then collected zero evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState all missing), failing the expected-output contract immediately. Because all three sibling checks hit the same endpoint and received the identical error message, the failure is in the shared swarm gateway layer, not in any per-check runner logic.
